concurrent_activity: Other CPU workloads and existing native previews remained active. Own builds finished before timing. No screenshot/input actions during the four sequential timing runs.
validation: Five populated image cases; max channel delta 2/255 and zero pixels over 2. All benchmark reports 1260 native frames, 360 samples/phase, 1320x954 canvas, 1 pixel/point and identical drawn counts. Both GPU profiles have 1260 unique frame tags, 4 bounded slots and zero errors/counters/pending.
limits: Strict 59.5 fps plus p95 <=16.9ms fails in every phase; original 60fps acceptance remains open.
Mixed GPU diagnostics and sequential variable-load measurements do not establish a general or isolated causal speedup.
GPU elapsed timestamps can include interference between timestamps and instrumentation overhead; instrumented cadence is diagnostic only.

Relative precision unit bound <0.001 point covers tested base vertices -512..3072 points and 1000 updates at zoom 0.1/10/100000 around world centers +/-8e12 mm. It does not guarantee nanometre model accuracy through the existing f64 scene boundary or arbitrary enormous primitive extents.

Native verification covers Intel Vulkan, default DPI (1 pixel/point) and single sample. Removing the storage-only gate allows baseline uniform-capable wgpu devices, but other adapters/backends/settings were not natively tested.
Layer generations still repack/upload resident geometry on changes or precision rebasing, and layers must fit device buffer limits.
